# Second report changes severity

`customer_support.heu.ticket_triage.second_report_changes_severity` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A second independent report of the same symptom is a severity change, not a second ticket.


## The heuristic

**A second independent report of the same symptom is a severity change, not a second ticket.**


_Why:_ Before engineering can reproduce anything, contact volume against one fault is usually the only blast-radius evidence in existence. Triaging the two independently deletes it.
